About Me

Pre

I write the scripts and storyboard every project in advance, planning the blocking, composition and lighting before the camera rolls.

Production

I film short films, web series and social content, bringing that plan to life so each shot serves the story.

Post

I edit short films, documentaries, music videos and commercials, and build visual effects through compositing, chroma keying, motion tracking and rotoscoping.
